data.title: 堀京子 · 把晴天夹上晾衣绳
data.description: 晨光里的阳台上，京子穿薄荷条纹衫和深蓝背带裤，抱着衣篮夹好最后一条毛巾。风突然把毛巾翻过来，她歪头看着自己的劳动成果，笑着重新按住一角。
data.action: 夹住被风翻起的毛巾角，歪头轻笑。
data.promptProse: Kyouko Hori carries the laundry basket against her indigo dungarees while clipping the last towel on the morning balcony. A gust flips the towel, and she tilts her head with a smile before pressing its corner flat. Her mint-and-white striped sleeves stay clear in the medium portrait. Soft morning daylight passes through the towel's raised edge, revealing its weave and leaving curved fabric shadows across the basket and railing.
